limits: gpu-allocator 0.27 ignores AllocatorCreateDesc.allocation_sizes and uses 64MiB host-visible / 256MiB device-local native blocks.
Existing free ranges are reused. If a new native block would leave insufficient budget headroom, the established dedicated allocation path is used.

The dependency exposes native allocation deltas after vkAllocateMemory. Rejected native growth is rolled back before publishing a resource; no strict pre-vkAllocateMemory instantaneous bound is claimed.
suballocator_peak_reserved_bytes retains the observed native reservation peak, including rejected transient growth.
All native capacity beyond exposed logical ranges, including internal aligned chunk padding, is charged as GPU Cache. Only wholly empty memory-type shards can be trimmed.

Dedicated S05 comparison saves 16512 bytes of actual native memory. Default suballocated comparison preserves identical pixels and does not add native memory blocks; range saving alone does not imply a reduction in retained native capacity.
